name: GR00T N1.7 3B
license_note: NVIDIA Open Model License. Cosmos-Reason2-2B, which this checkpoint loads, is gated.
notes: GR00T N1.7 keeps 16 of Cosmos-Reason2-2B's 28 text layers (select_layer=16) and reads that hidden state from the flow-matching action head. The eval truncates the Cosmos architecture to however many text layers the checkpoint actually contains, copies those weights, and keeps the Cosmos lm_head when the checkpoint has none. Compare against cosmos_reason2_2b_layer16, not the full 28-layer model.
convention: question used verbatim (it carries 'Choices: A. ...' and the answer instruction), greedy; VLMEvalKit can_infer exact matching, unparsed is wrong
